subject: Re: Kickoff: progressive distillation for diffusion serving costs
body:
Decisions for the close of the half.

1. We ship the 8-step model. Rosa landed the final stage on June 29, inside the reservation, and Oyin's eval battery shows FID within 0.4 of the 256-step teacher with human-pref parity on 3 of 4 prompt categories.
2. The 4-step push moves to Q3. The remaining category gap (fine text rendering) is exactly where aggressive step reduction hurts, and I will not spend LRB credibility on it.
3. Paloma's serving integration goes to the Launch Review Board on July 23 -- projected serving cost reduction is 31x on sampling compute vs. the 256-step baseline.

Excellent half. This is the poster child for the efficiency portfolio and I intend to use it that way.

Zofia
